Ticket:
Frustrated with patient portal password reset and account unlocking issues

Good grief, I am at my wits' end trying to deal with the patient portal accounts today. Patients constantly call my desk because they are locked out or cannot remember their passwords, and the tool to reset or unlock their access is buried under three different menus. I tried walking an elderly patient through the password recovery link this morning, but the verification email never arrived in their inbox even after I clicked resend three times, which completely stalled our check-in flow. Can you please explain why these reset links are failing and how I am actually supposed to clear out these locked portal accounts quickly without wasting twenty minutes per person?
